Access, storage and deletion

Examples only

Do not enter real patient information, real employee numbers or real staff email addresses. Sample registration accepts DEMO employee numbers and .example.test email addresses. Shared sample credentials do not verify healthcare employment.

Who can do what

Piezas manages passwords and signed sessions. The app checks the approved staff role on the server for each request. EMS staff work with requests from their assigned base. Hospital staff review requests addressed to their assigned hospital. The sample administrator reviews access requests, assigns roles, sets backup rules and deletes example requests.

Medical responsibility

The app checks required coordination fields. It does not use AI to screen patients, make clinical decisions, promise a safe waiting time or provide 24/7 review coverage. Qualified staff would need to make medical decisions in a real deployment.

Where records stay

Coordination requests, staff assignments, decisions and audit metadata are stored in Piezas. Passwords and sessions stay in its managed users service, not in request records. The hosted app uses HTTPS; this page does not claim independently assessed healthcare compliance or a particular provider backup policy.

When records are deleted

Example requests remain until an administrator reviews and explicitly deletes them using the exact reference and a reason. Deleted requests are not automatically recreated. Minimal administrative history, including the reference, staff identity, reason and time, remains for the project lifetime. Automatic purging and erasure of provider backups are not configured.

Sample staff accounts, access requests and role decisions remain for the project lifetime. Rejecting or suspending staff removes their app access; it does not erase the administrative history. Managed account and provider-backup deletion require the app owner’s separate review.

Before any real patient use

The team must agree on a real verified administrator and employment checks, suitable staff access controls, a legally reviewed retention schedule, backup deletion rules, security review and clinical governance. Real patient information remains blocked in this prototype.

If no one responds or the app is unavailable

Use the backup contact and response target configured by the administrator as a sample workflow. Record escalation in the app and contact the backup directly. No email, SMS, emergency dispatch or external alert is sent by recording an escalation. Follow your organization’s established offline process for urgent coordination.
